name: My Room #4
description:
Who will dare to face the challenge of the Funhouse?

Funhouse is a progressive blues tune, with generative sound design elements that compliment 13 murderous rooms of generative mixed media art, featuring creepy clowns, dolls and more.  

This collection has three legendary, murderous rooms full of deadly surprises. 

When was the last time you visited the Funhouse?

Recorded at Salt Spring Studios
Music by Emil G Music
Tina Guo on electric cello
Art by SpaDogs

Quadraphonic is encoded using Involve Encode™ Surround Stereo down-mix & universal stereo audio format.
